note: make rebaseline SILENTLY SKIPS the atlas bundle when  is off PATH. scripts/regenerate-artifacts.sh guards the atlas build with , warns to STDERR, and continues rc=0. deno is not on the Mac default PATH (it lives at ~/.deno/bin), so book/src/gallery/atlas.js -- which IS in docs/generated-paths.txt and IS drift-checked every gate -- is never rebuilt. That is the exact vacuous-drift shape the drift list exists to prevent: a stale committed bundle passes forever, and the only signal is one stderr line in a 700-line log. Workaround: PATH=OME/.deno/bin:ATH make rebaseline. Filed as TOOL-rebaseline-skips-the-atlas-bundle-without-deno (The Escapement).
